[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-zr.7.1.1[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Gate decision integrity: owned execution, durable failure outcomes,[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]truthful completion[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]An accepted gate decision can never be superseded or cancelled [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]while its execution owner is live; every post-acceptance failure [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim](option command, terminal preparation or archive, side effects, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]follow-up, or owner death) leaves a redacted, durable, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]receipt-scoped failure outcome; attempt_completed is journaled only[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]after the response is published; resume retries only the failed [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]work; poll_gate and every waiting requester receive a failure [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]result instead of a false pending or already_answered; and each [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]failure publishes one deduped notification carrying resume, restart[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and cancel recovery.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/gate_decision_integrity_1.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-zr/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]sase-zr.7.1.1.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Execution owner, failure outcome and liveness policy in [/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]sase-core[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]core_execution_policy[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core_execution_policy: in sase-core, add the execution owner, acceptance[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]id, execution-facts and failure-outcome wires; make [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]decide_gate_decision_acceptance reject conflicts while the owner is live[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and supersede only after a failed outcome or a proven-dead owner; add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cancellation-over-receipt precedence and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]accepted_failed/accepted_owner_lost dispositions with cancel/supersede [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]permissions to decide_gate_lifecycle; add claim_gate_decision_execution;[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cover it with Rust and PyO3 binding tests; land it so release-plz [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]publishes it.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Receipt-scoped journal, truthful attempt completion and [/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]durable failure outcomes[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]failure_journal[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core_execution_policy[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]failure_journal: in sase, adopt the new core revision, stamp every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]receipt and journal lifecycle event with an acceptance id, record a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]redacted attempt_failed outcome for command, terminal_prepare, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]side_effects and follow_up failures, journal attempt_completed only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]after response.json is published, make resume retry only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]archive/terminal preparation or failed side effects without re-running [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]completed commands, and keep legacy early-completed journals resumable.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Verifiable owner, live-owner conflict rejection and [/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]post-failure supersede/cancel[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]owner_conflict[dim] · [dim][/dim]after failure_journal[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]owner_conflict: in sase, record the execution owner on every receipt, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]collect lock/pid/proc liveness and failure facts for the core policy, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reject a conflicting answer while the owner is live, supersede or cancel[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]only after a failed outcome or proven-dead owner, re-own the receipt [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]under the acceptance lock before execution, and teach lifecycle, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reclaim, gate show and gate cancel the new dispositions.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Failure results for requesters and deduped recovery [/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]notifications[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]failure_surfacing[dim] · [dim][/dim]after owner_conflict[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]failure_surfacing: in sase, give poll_gate a failed status, record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]owner_lost on the poll and reclaim paths, keep waiting requesters honest[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through their deadlines, update sase gate wait and the other requesters,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]publish one deduped GateExecutionFailed notification per failure with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resume/restart/cancel recovery, dismiss it on success, supersede or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cancel, add a minimal ACE fallback for the new action, and run the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]combined verification.[/#D7D7AF]
